Rule.title: Repository contract violation
Rule.description: Aggregate ports expose only identity-load/save. Effective inherited members, generic substitutions and each adapter interface implementation are evaluated per port; query-only views exclude exposed write and mutable domain capabilities.

Rule.title: Use case or handler should not inject IServiceProvider
Rule.message: Use case or handler '{0}' injects IServiceProvider; inject explicit dependencies instead
Rule.description: Use cases should declare explicit dependencies and avoid service locator style access.

Rule.title: Domain model should not depend on DbContext
Rule.description: Domain aggregates and entities must not reference the recognized DbContext role in their own type syntax. This bounded check does not cover every infrastructure technology.

Rule.title: Controller should have effective ApiControllerAttribute
Rule.message: Controller '{0}' has no effective ASP.NET Core ApiControllerAttribute
Rule.description: Recognized concrete controllers require the ASP.NET Core attribute on the type, a base type, or the assembly. The controller scope still includes MVC ControllerBase; this does not prove runtime routing.

Rule.title: Controller should not access persistence directly
Rule.message: Controller '{0}' directly references persistence member or type '{1}'
Rule.description: Controllers must not reference DbContext or call recognized persistence write APIs. Method identity, overrides and interface implementations are checked; unrelated same-named methods are not persistence evidence.

Rule.title: Controller should not construct handlers or use cases
Rule.message: Controller '{0}' directly constructs '{1}'; inject a Use Case interface instead
Rule.description: Controllers should receive explicit Use Case interfaces through dependency injection.

Rule.title: Mapper should be static
Rule.message: Mapper '{0}' must be a static class
Rule.description: The selected object-mapper policy requires a static class. This shape alone does not prove purity, determinism or absence of mutable static state.

Rule.title: Mapper should not depend on application or persistence services
Rule.description: Object mappers must not depend on repositories, use cases, or handlers.

Rule.title: Event-sourced aggregate state should change through event transitions
Rule.message: Event-sourced aggregate '{0}' mutates member '{1}' outside its contract event transition
Rule.description: Local instance state mutation requires the canonical virtual event transition declared by an exact ES contract or its override. Constructors, collections and indirect helper effects are not replay or transaction proofs.

Rule.title: Use case should not use service locator or attribute injection
Rule.message: Use case or handler '{0}' uses forbidden dependency resolution '{1}'
Rule.description: Use cases must declare explicit constructor dependencies and must not use service locator or attribute-based injection.

Rule.title: Handler should not mix command and query responsibilities
Rule.message: Handler '{0}' handles both command and query marker types
Rule.description: CQRS handlers must keep command and query responsibilities separate.

Rule.title: Use case should not construct repositories
Rule.message: Use case or handler '{0}' directly constructs repository type '{1}'
Rule.description: Repository ports must be injected into use cases; concrete repository construction belongs in the composition root.

Rule.title: Projection should not perform persistence writes
Rule.description: Query readers must not call recognized DbContext or DbSet write APIs, including overrides and interface implementations. Projector store ownership and arbitrary side effects are not analyzed.

Rule.title: Controller must depend on a Use Case boundary
Rule.message: Controller '{0}' injects forbidden dependency '{1}'; inject a Use Case interface instead
Rule.description: Controllers must not inject handlers, buses, dispatchers, write repositories, or Domain services. An exact PureQuery controller selection permits only a query-only repository or query-service dependency view.

Rule.title: Use Case contract shape is invalid
Rule.message: Use Case '{0}' violates the canonical contract: {1}
Rule.description: Use Cases use ExecuteAsync, a non-optional CancellationToken, and transport-neutral input/output contracts, and must not expose Handler entry points.

Rule.title: Use Case dependency is forbidden
Rule.message: Use Case '{0}' depends on forbidden type '{1}'
Rule.description: Use Cases must not depend directly on IMessageBus, mediators/dispatchers, transport contracts, or another Use Case.

Rule.title: Dispatch Handler must adapt to one Use Case
Rule.message: Dispatch Handler '{0}' violates the Handler boundary: {1}
Rule.description: Command and Query dispatch handlers declare exactly one distinct Use Case dependency type and no repository or Domain-service dependency. This does not attest invocation count or control flow.

Rule.title: Value Object must not expose mutable state
Rule.message: Value Object '{0}' has mutable state at '{1}': {2}
Rule.description: Opt-in DDD policy rejects setters, mutable fields and known mutable containers; init alone is permitted.

Rule.title: Value Object must not reference an Entity
Rule.message: Value Object '{0}' references an Entity through '{1}'
Rule.description: Opt-in DDD policy checks declared instance state and known container paths; it does not infer arbitrary wrapper storage.
